What matches

  • The layout is right: two sandals, heel loops and forefoot straps.
  • 86% of the outline overlaps.

What is off

  • The soles are too thick.
  • The straps are chunky and crumpled; yours are clean, smooth loops.

What I did

  1. Built a sandals generator. A sole outline (heel, ball and toe) with a raised lip, a heel loop and crossing straps over the forefoot. Every piece is generated by Python in Blender, then given paper thickness and flat facets.
  2. Cut out your image. I separated the sandals from the backdrop so its outline can be scored.
  3. Found your camera. I tried several turns and kept the one whose outline matched best.
  4. Fitted the shape. 300 small changes to the dimensions, each kept only if the outline got closer.
  5. Fitted light and paper. 20 rendered rounds tuning light, paper colour and backdrop.
  6. Second pass. Camera held to a sensible range, cream paper and builder fixes, then fitted again.
